q: How many monitoring locations are in the database?
How many daily measurements are there in total?
Which city has the highest average PM2.5? Give the city name.
sql: SELECT l.city FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id JOIN locations l ON s.location_id=l.location_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25' GROUP BY l.city ORDER BY AVG(m.value) DESC LIMIT 1

q: Which city has the lowest average PM2.5? Give the city name.
sql: SELECT l.city FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id JOIN locations l ON s.location_id=l.location_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25' GROUP BY l.city ORDER BY AVG(m.value) ASC LIMIT 1

q: What is the overall average PM2.5 across all cities?
sql: SELECT AVG(m.value) FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25'

q: What is the average PM2.5 in Delhi?
sql: SELECT AVG(m.value) FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id JOIN locations l ON s.location_id=l.location_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25' AND l.city='Delhi'

q: Which month has the highest average PM2.5 across all cities? Give the month number.
sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%m', m.date) AS INTEGER) mo FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25' GROUP BY mo ORDER BY AVG(m.value) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many cities have an average PM2.5 above 100?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT l.city FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id JOIN locations l ON s.location_id=l.location_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25' GROUP BY l.city HAVING AVG(m.value) > 100)

q: What is the highest single daily PM2.5 value recorded?
sql: SELECT MAX(m.value) FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25'

q: What is the average PM10 across all cities?
sql: SELECT AVG(m.value) FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id WHERE s.parameter='pm10'

q: Which city has the highest average PM10? Give the city name.
sql: SELECT l.city FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id JOIN locations l ON s.location_id=l.location_id WHERE s.parameter='pm10' GROUP BY l.city ORDER BY AVG(m.value) DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average PM2.5 during winter months (Nov, Dec, Jan)?
sql: SELECT AVG(m.value) FROM measurements m JOIN sensors s ON m.sensor_id=s.sensor_id WHERE s.parameter='pm25' AND CAST(strftime('%m', m.date) AS INTEGER) IN (11,12,1)
